data.gender_notes: Awlia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who provides assistance, support, and comfort to others, often used to refer to saints and spiritual teachers. The name Awlia carries the meaning “Friend, helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awlia usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Awlia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, helper, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awlia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
